text: The Tundra plan (Nov 3–10) covers six modules: upload, billing, catalog, media, auth, and notify. Catalog runs on worker beta with max_workers 18 and batch_size 500, replacing the withdrawn drafts. Upload runs on worker gamma, and media must run on a different worker. Notify and billing share one worker. Media owns hooks.py and guard.py and must not depend on auth, directly or indirectly. Upload and billing both use batch_size 200. If catalog.max_workers exceeds 16, auth.retry_limit must be at most 2. If billing batch_size exceeds 100, media queue_depth must be at least 490. Rollout requires auth before billing, and notify depends on both catalog and media. The security review is at month end, and the budget review is next Thursday. The team decides auth placement on beta, upload ttl_s (around 270), post-launch design reviews, and the client demo timing at the next checkpoint.
